title: The passive with se: what was built and used

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *se* from B1 Unit 6: *se* + a third-person verb says what was done without saying who did it. The verb agrees with the thing: *se construyó una ciudad*, *se construyeron ciudades*. It is useful for outlining a whole civilisation.

items.spanish: En Mesoamérica se construyeron pirámides de piedra.
items.english: In Mesoamerica, stone pyramids were built.

items.spanish: En los Andes se usaban quipus para llevar las cuentas.
items.english: In the Andes, quipus were used to keep accounts.

items.spanish: En las dos regiones se cultivaba el maíz.
items.english: In both regions, maize was grown.

sections.content: Use the preterite for a single event (*se fundó*) and the imperfect for something that went on or was habitual (*se usaban*, *se cultivaba*). The verb is plural when the thing is plural: *se construyeron pirámides*, never *se construyó pirámides*.
